pages.alt: One whole bar with 3 of its 3 cuts made, making 4 equal pieces, each labelled one quarter.
pages.name: One whole, four quarters

pages.text: This bar is one [[whole]]. Cut it into 4 equal pieces and each piece is a [[quarter]].

pages.name: Colour one quarter
pages.why: The 4 cuts the bar into four equal pieces. The 1 says to colour one of them.

pages.alt: A bar cut into 4 quarters with 3 shaded and counted. Beside 3/4, the 3 counts the pieces and the 4 names the piece.
pages.name: Three quarters
pages.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 340 140" width="340" style="fill:#1d1f22;stroke:none;stroke-width:1px;font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:400;text-anchor:start" height="140"><style>.s0{stroke:#a9afb6;stroke-width:2px}.s1{fill:#fff;font-weight:700;text-anchor:middle}.s2{stroke:#fff;stroke-width:5.5px;stroke-linejoin:round;font-size:22px;font-weight:700;text-anchor:middle;paint-order:stroke}.s3{fill:#0b6a70;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:3.75px;stroke-linejoin:round;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;paint-order:stroke}</style><rect x="20" y="4" width="75" height="56" class="s0"/><text x="57.5" y="38" text-anchor="middle" class="s1">1</text><rect x="95" y="4" width="75" height="56" class="s0"/><text x="132.5" y="38" text-anchor="middle" class="s1">2</text><rect x="170" y="4" width="75" height="56" class="s0"/><text x="207.5" y="38" text-anchor="middle" class="s1">3</text><rect x="245" y="4" width="75" height="56" style="fill:#fafaf8;stroke:#a9afb6;stroke-width:2px"/><rect x="20" y="4" width="300" height="56" style="fill:none;stroke:#a9afb6;stroke-width:2.5px"/><text x="60" y="99" text-anchor="middle" class="s2">3</text><line x1="47" y1="104" x2="73" y2="104" style="stroke:#1d1f22;stroke-width:2px"/><text x="60" y="128" text-anchor="middle" class="s2">4</text><text x="90" y="97" text-anchor="start" class="s3">counts the pieces</text><text x="90" y="126" text-anchor="start" class="s3">names the piece</text></svg>
pages.text: 3/4 means three of those quarters. The bottom number [[names the piece]]. The top number [[counts]] them.

pages.name: Colour three quarters
pages.why: The bottom number, 4, cuts the bar into four equal pieces. The top number, 3, says to colour three of them.

pages.alt: A square cut into one wide top piece and two small bottom pieces. The wide piece is shaded and labelled one half, and each small piece is one quarter.
pages.name: Equal pieces
pages.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 340 216" width="340" style="fill:#1d1f22;stroke:none;stroke-width:1px;font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:400;text-anchor:start" height="216"><style>.s0{fill:#fafaf8;stroke:#a9afb6;stroke-width:2px}.s1{fill:#fff;font-weight:700;text-anchor:middle}.s2{stroke:#fff;stroke-width:3.75px;stroke-linejoin:round;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;text-anchor:middle;paint-order:stroke}.s3{stroke:#1d1f22;stroke-width:1.5px}</style><rect x="70" y="6" width="204" height="102" style="stroke:#a9afb6;stroke-width:2px"/><rect x="70" y="108" width="102" height="102" class="s0"/><rect x="172" y="108" width="102" height="102" class="s0"/><rect x="70" y="6" width="204" height="204" style="fill:none;stroke:#a9afb6;stroke-width:2.5px"/><text x="172" y="56" text-anchor="middle" class="s1">1</text><line x1="163" y1="61" x2="181" y2="61" style="stroke:#fff;stroke-width:1.5px"/><text x="172" y="77" text-anchor="middle" class="s1">2</text><text x="121" y="158" text-anchor="middle" class="s2">1</text><line x1="112" y1="163" x2="130" y2="163" class="s3"/><text x="121" y="179" text-anchor="middle" class="s2">4</text><text x="223" y="158" text-anchor="middle" class="s2">1</text><line x1="214" y1="163" x2="232" y2="163" class="s3"/><text x="223" y="179" text-anchor="middle" class="s2">4</text></svg>
pages.text: [[Half]] means half the space, not half the pieces. This square has one big piece and two small ones. The big piece takes up half the square on its own.

pages.name: Colour half the square
pages.why: Half means half the space, not half the pieces. The left piece is half on its own, and so are the two small ones together.

pages.alt: A bar with 3 of 4 quarters shaded above a number line from 0 to 1. A line drops from the end of the shading to a mark at 3/4.
pages.name: A place on the line
pages.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 340 166" width="340" style="fill:#1d1f22;stroke:none;stroke-width:1px;font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:400;text-anchor:start" height="166"><style>.s0{stroke:#a9afb6;stroke-width:2px}.s1{stroke:#1d1f22;stroke-width:2px}.s2{stroke:#fff;stroke-width:4px;stroke-linejoin:round;font-weight:700;text-anchor:middle;paint-order:stroke}.s3{stroke:#fff;stroke-width:3.75px;stroke-linejoin:round;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;text-anchor:middle;paint-order:stroke}</style><rect x="20" y="4" width="75" height="48" class="s0"/><rect x="95" y="4" width="75" height="48" class="s0"/><rect x="170" y="4" width="75" height="48" class="s0"/><rect x="245" y="4" width="75" height="48" style="fill:#fafaf8;stroke:#a9afb6;stroke-width:2px"/><rect x="20" y="4" width="300" height="48" style="fill:none;stroke:#a9afb6;stroke-width:2.5px"/><line x1="20" y1="112" x2="320" y2="112" style="stroke:#1d1f22;stroke-width:2.5px;stroke-linecap:round"/><line x1="20" y1="100" x2="20" y2="124" class="s1"/><text x="20" y="146" text-anchor="middle" class="s2">0</text><line x1="95" y1="104" x2="95" y2="120" class="s1"/><line x1="170" y1="104" x2="170" y2="120" class="s1"/><line x1="245" y1="104" x2="245" y2="120" class="s1"/><line x1="320" y1="100" x2="320" y2="124" class="s1"/><text x="320" y="146" text-anchor="middle" class="s2">1</text><line x1="245" y1="52" x2="245" y2="112" style="stroke:#1d1f22;stroke-width:2px;stroke-dasharray:5px, 4px"/><circle cx="245" cy="112" r="9" style="stroke:#fff;stroke-width:2.5px"/><text x="245" y="137" text-anchor="middle" class="s3">3</text><line x1="236" y1="142" x2="254" y2="142" style="stroke:#1d1f22;stroke-width:1.5px"/><text x="245" y="158" text-anchor="middle" class="s3">4</text></svg>
pages.text: A fraction is also a place on a [[number line]]. Shade 3/4 of the bar and drop straight down. The mark lands at 3/4.

pages.name: Find 3/4 on the line
pages.task: Tap where 3/4 goes on the line.
pages.why: Count three quarter-steps from 0. Where you stop is the number 3/4.

pages.name: Which is bigger?
pages.why: Bigger numbers don't make a bigger fraction. Five eighths is a little less than three quarters.

pages.alt: Two bars of 4 quarters each, with 7 quarters counted, filling the first bar and 3 of the second.
pages.name: Past one
pages.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 340 176" width="340" style="fill:#1d1f22;stroke:none;stroke-width:1px;font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:400;text-anchor:start" height="176"><style>.s0{stroke:#a9afb6;stroke-width:2px}.s1{fill:#fff;font-weight:700;text-anchor:middle}.s2{fill:none;stroke:#a9afb6;stroke-width:2.5px}.s3{fill:#0b6a70;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:3.75px;stroke-linejoin:round;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;text-anchor:middle;paint-order:stroke}</style><rect x="20" y="24" width="75" height="56" class="s0"/><text x="57.5" y="58" text-anchor="middle" class="s1">1</text><rect x="95" y="24" width="75" height="56" class="s0"/><text x="132.5" y="58" text-anchor="middle" class="s1">2</text><rect x="170" y="24" width="75" height="56" class="s0"/><text x="207.5" y="58" text-anchor="middle" class="s1">3</text><rect x="245" y="24" width="75" height="56" class="s0"/><text x="282.5" y="58" text-anchor="middle" class="s1">4</text><rect x="20" y="24" width="300" height="56" class="s2"/><rect x="20" y="112" width="75" height="56" class="s0"/><text x="57.5" y="146" text-anchor="middle" class="s1">5</text><rect x="95" y="112" width="75" height="56" class="s0"/><text x="132.5" y="146" text-anchor="middle" class="s1">6</text><rect x="170" y="112" width="75" height="56" class="s0"/><text x="207.5" y="146" text-anchor="middle" class="s1">7</text><rect x="245" y="112" width="75" height="56" style="fill:#fafaf8;stroke:#a9afb6;stroke-width:2px"/><rect x="20" y="112" width="300" height="56" class="s2"/><text x="170" y="16" text-anchor="middle" class="s3">four quarters, one whole</text><text x="132.5" y="104" text-anchor="middle" class="s3">three more quarters</text></svg>
pages.text: Keep counting past four quarters and you go past 1. Seven quarters fill one bar and three of the next. That is 7/4, also written 1 3/4.

pages.name: Colour seven quarters
pages.why: Four quarters fill one whole bar. Three more go into the next, so 7/4 is one whole and three quarters, written 1 3/4.

pages.name: Find 7/4 on the line
pages.task: Tap where 7/4 goes on the line.
pages.why: Seven quarter-steps from 0 takes you past 1 and three steps more.
